verdict.rationale: Summer Engine runs production backends (servers, player saves, analytics), so an isolated sandbox environment is a fair question, but the evidence documents none. The `--dry-run` flag only previews the agent-config install plan, which is a dry-run rather than sandbox isolation. `--channel next` and early-build playtesting are adjacent features that do not separate test data from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
